description: COMPONENT PATTERN GOLDEN (ASM-A3-PATTERN): five 40 x 25 x 10 mm two-hole plates (the sketch-extrude-plate-2holes part: r5 holes at (12, 12.5) and (28, 12.5)) and one pattern of each kind. A, grounded at the origin, and A2, grounded at (0, -100, 0), drive a HOLE pattern (Replicate) of plate P, which a rigid joint seats on A's hole-1 top rim; L, grounded at (0, 100, 0), is LINEAR-patterned 3 x 50 mm (typed '2 * 25 mm') along A's bottom front edge; C, grounded at (200, 0, 0), is CIRCULAR-patterned 4 x 360 deg about A's hole-2 top rim. Locks: copies placed from SOLVED poses (P's copies follow its joint), the hole matching rule (same radius, same plane, parallel axis), a second driving instance (also_on), a straight-edge direction, a circular-edge axis through the hole centre with Z out of the top face, pattern_copy_id, and the per-pattern counts.
derivation: Expectations are HAND-DERIVED, not recorded pipeline output. The plate's own mass properties are the sketch-extrude-plate-2holes golden's: volume 8429.203673205104 mm^3, surface_area 3614.159265358979 mm^2, centroid (20, 12.5, 5), AABB [0,0,0]..[40,25,10], 8 faces / 18 edges / 1 shell.

P: the rigid joint pairs A's hole-1 TOP rim (A-local (12, 12.5, 10), Z = +Z out of the top face, X = +X) with P's hole-1 BOTTOM rim (P-local (12, 12.5, 0), Z = -Z, X = +X). F_P = F_A o RotX(180) gives world X = +X and Z = -Z, so R_P = I and t_P = (12, 12.5, 10) - (12, 12.5, 0) = (0, 0, 10). A, A2, L and C are grounded at their seeds: remaining_dof 0, well_constrained.

HOLE pattern (order 0, seed P, seed hole = A's hole-1 top rim, r = 5, on the plane z = 10): the plate's circles of radius 5 centred on z = 10 with an axis parallel to Z are its two top rims, centres (12, 12.5, 10) and (28, 12.5, 10), sorted by coordinates. Copies run over the drivers [A, A2] and each one's holes in order, skipping A's hole 1 (the seed's own): T = W_j o Trans(c_h - c_0) o W_A^-1 with W_A = I. k1: A hole 2, Trans(16, 0, 0): P at (16, 0, 10). k2: A2 hole 1, Trans(0, -100, 0): (0, -100, 10). k3: A2 hole 2, Trans(16, -100, 0): (16, -100, 10). Count: 2 holes x 2 drivers = 4.
LINEAR pattern (order 1, seed L): A's edge (0,0,0)-(40,0,0); its canonical start is (0,0,0), so the direction is +X. Copies at k x 50 along +X: (50, 100, 0) and (100, 100, 0). Count 3.

CIRCULAR pattern (order 2, seed C): the axis through A's hole-2 top rim centre p = (28, 12.5, 10), Z = +Z (out of the top face). A full ring of 4: step 90 deg. Copy k: R = RotZ(90k), t = R t_C + p - R p. k1: R (200, 0, 0) = (0, 200, 0); p - R p = (28, 12.5) - (-12.5, 28) = (40.5, -15.5); t = (40.5, 184.5, 0), q = (0, 0, s, s) with s = 0.7071067811865476. k2: R t_C = (-200, 0, 0); p - R p = (56, 25); t = (-144, 25, 0), q = (0, 0, 1, 0). k3: R (x, y) = (y, -x): R t_C = (0, -200, 0); p - R p = (28 - 12.5, 12.5 + 28) = (15.5, 40.5); t = (15.5, -159.5, 0), q = (0, 0, -s, s) (compared as a rotation matrix, so the -q double cover is immaterial).

Copy ids: loft_wire.component_patterns.pattern_copy_id = uuid5(pattern id, '<seed id>/<k>'). Hole (pattern ...d1, seed ...c2): 7af0f8c2, e682014d, 2d5b162b. Linear (...d2, seed ...c3): 64daf23e, 4c823d71. Circular (...d3, seed ...c4): 0c7f40bf, 4ea71d41, ed540af9.

Combined bounding_box: the unrotated plates span x [0, 140] and [200, 240], y [-100, 125], z [0, 20]; C1 x [15.5, 40.5], y [184.5, 224.5]; C2 x [-184, -144], y [0, 25]; C3 x [15.5, 40.5], y [-199.5, -159.5]. Quarter and half turns, so the corner unions are exact. Union [-184, -199.5, 0]..[240, 224.5, 20].
tolerance_rationale: CLOSED-FORM tolerance: every placement is a grounded seed, a closed-form rigid joint, or a seed moved by an exact translation or quarter turn, so every pose is analytic to float64 round-off. Measured first (2026-10-15, build123d 0.11.1 / OCCT 7.9, numpy BLAS pinned to 1 thread): every position within 3.8e-14 mm, rotation matrices within 4.5e-16, centroid within 7.2e-15 mm, combined volume within 3e-11 mm^3 (summation order of 13 part volumes). 1e-9 matches the S4a joint and nested goldens. Loosening it requires a reviewed justification here and in docs/GEOMETRY-QA.md.

probes.note: C1 is C turned 90 deg about the axis through A's hole 2: C's own hole-2 top centre, 200 from the axis along +X at (228, 12.5, 10), lands 200 from it along +Y: RotZ(90) (28, 12.5, 10) + (40.5, 184.5, 0) = (28, 212.5, 10)
P3's hole-1 bottom centre sits on A2's hole-2 top centre (28, 12.5, 10) + (0, -100, 0), exactly as P's sits on A's hole 1
